[[Kawkab Marrakesh|KAC Marrakesh]] | prevseason = [[2017–18 Botola|2017–18]] | nextseason = [[2019–20 Botola|2019–20]] }} The '''2018–19 Botola''', also known as '''Botola Maroc Telecom''' for sponsorship reasons, is the 62nd season of the Premier League and the 8th under its new format of Moroccan Pro League, the top Moroccan professional league for [[association football]] clubs, since its establishment in 1956. The season started on 25 August 2018 and ended on 15 May 2019. [[IR Tanger]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[2017–18 Botola|2017–18 season]].
